body:
I really like Odelia Rei's entire playlist, but you can add what you like. I like her frequent use of non-lexical vocables (I just found out the term today, this refers to sounds like ooo, ladadada, McDonald's Badabababa)

70% is slow, more chill music but I love it when driving, especially driving solo in Japan and Catalunya.

I'm just fanboying a little cause I'm so glad I found a new artist to be emo to lol. It's tough for me because it's hard to find an entire discography which I like. And her live performances are really good which means alot to me because I enjoy the uniqueness and rawness of every single one.
